# Anne Shirley & Jane Andrews

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) — playmates · since v1  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P2](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P7](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0007)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) accuses [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of losing her amethyst brooch and confines her to her room until she confesses. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) concocts a false confession in hopes of attending the picnic, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) forbids her from going anyway. Soon after, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discovers the brooch caught in her shawl, realizes her mistake, and happily sends [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) off to enjoy the picnic after all.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P14](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P35](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0035), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P56](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0056), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P62](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk to school, discussing their scenic route, local school gossip, and the return of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). In the classroom, Gilbert pulls Anne's braid and calls her 'Carrots,' prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to smash her slate over his head in anger. Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md) punishes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand in front of the class, and despite Gilbert's contrite apology afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses to forgive him.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P3](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044)_

> During a party, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accepts Josie Pye's dare to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, resulting in a fall that breaks her ankle. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) realizes how deeply she cares for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as the injured girl is brought home, and during her weeks of recovery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys visits from friends while eagerly anticipating returning to school under their new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to school in October and thrives under the guidance of her new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md). She enthusiastically shares her school activities with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), including plans for an upcoming Christmas concert. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) remains skeptical of the festivities, [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) offers [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his warm encouragement.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXIV. Miss Stacy and Her Pupils Get Up a Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turns thirteen and talks with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) on their walk to school about growing up, writing compositions, and her melodramatic story. Inspired, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forms a story club with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), Ruby, and Jane, which [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) scoffs at when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) describes their efforts.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and her friends reenact Tennyson's Elaine on a leaky flatboat, forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to cling to a bridge pile until [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) rescues her. When Gilbert apologizes and asks to be friends, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refuses, though she later reflects on her foolishness with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md).
>

> As the school term ends, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md) reassures her students that she will return next year to prepare them for the [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) exams. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) resolves to spend her summer vacation playing and letting her imagination run free. Meanwhile, [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for tea and praises [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) for how remarkably well [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has grown and improved over the past three years.
>

> [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) dress for the charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), where [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) pops in to inspect her. After driving over with Jane and [Billy](../character/billy.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) feels insecure among the sophisticated attendees, but when overcome by stage fright on platform, the sight of [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) motivates her to perform splendidly and earn an encore.
>
> — v1 · CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the stage for an encore performance to avoid disappointing [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), winning over the audience and guests at the concert. Afterwards, she dines with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and Jane, introduced to everyone by the pink lady, before [Billy](../character/billy.md) drives them home under the moonlight while they discuss the evening, wealth, and contentment.
>

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) settles into student life at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy), forming close friendships and maintaining her healthy academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). She spends time visiting [Aunt Josephine](../character/josephine-barry.md) [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) and eventually prepares alongside her [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates as spring brings upcoming final examinations.
